ns2:course.label: Topics in Scan Languages
ns2:course.description: Advanced Scandinavian languages instruction. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 9 undergraduate or 9 graduate hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: SCAN 104 or equivalent as approved by instructor.
